verdict.rationale: Warp documents several retention controls: local Blocks can be kept from being saved or cleared from a machine entirely, conversation history can be managed, and telemetry can be opted out. It also says terminal input/output is never stored on its servers, and Business/Enterprise plans get a Zero Data Retention agreement with admin-panel privacy controls. These controls are tiered, though: ZDR is limited to higher plans and Free users must keep telemetry on to use AI. missing for 10: user-initiated deletion of server-side account/AI data, configurable retention periods, ZDR outside Business/Enterprise, independent corroboration of retention claims.
